title: Therese B NDE 5369
content: I was 18 years old. I had been living a very destructive life for the last few years and I was staying in an institution for problem youth. I was very egotistical and tough, and I did not care for others or myself. I smoked and drank alcohol, and had no plans for my life. My life was in chaos, and psychologically, down deep, I felt very bad. One day in 1998 during the summer (or early fall – I do not remember exactly, because I did not save any newspaper clippings) a woman from the personnel department at the youth home took me shopping in Karlstad to buy me some clothes. We were finished shopping and were on our way home. The two of us, as well as some other people, were standing together by a pedestrian-walk waiting for the light to turn green so we could cross the road. Suddenly a van stopped and waved for us to cross. I looked at the traffic signal and it was green. I was the first one to walk out in front of the van. I passed in front of it and stepped into the next lane. Suddenly, I saw, out of the corner of my eye, a red car bearing down on me at full speed. I remember realizing that it was going to hit me and that I might die. Instantly, I am in a different dimension–in a beautiful place, which is filled with gorgeous white and golden rays of light. In front of me, there is a large group of people, looking so good and happy, all welcoming me. I feel right at home, as if returning to my real family after a long trip away. Another Consciousness is speaking directly to me, and it feels like our Father. This Being is love, safety, happiness, understanding, consciousness and freedom! I become aware that I now understand everything and that I have answers to all my questions. Now everything is very clear to me! The Higher Consciousness shows me what my life has been so far, and I realize that I have not yet done what I am supposed to do. The Consciousness helps me understand that I can choose to go back to my life on Earth, or be finished with it and move on. As I reflect on the choice, I realize that I have not found my purpose in life and that I want to find it. I want to fulfill my purpose. I know that once I have lived my life, and have done what I am supposed to do, I will return so I choose to continue my Earthly life and do the best that I can with it! After this, I hear someone talking to me in a worried voice. I tell her that everything will be fine, and that she should not be sad. Then I remember being in an ambulance and someone asking me for my social security number. Witnesses say that the van stopped and that I crossed in front of it, but that the light was still red, not green, the way I remember it. The red car hit me on my side, and I flew up on top of its hood, then up in the air, and dropped down to the ground, bouncing on the asphalt twice. Then I lay completely still. Everything happened in just a few seconds, but I experienced being in the other dimension for a much longer time. The woman that had taken me shopping was sure I had died, and was very shocked. I spent two days in the hospital and was fairly good considering. I only had a concussion, a broken tooth and some bruising. After the accident, I became totally different and started loving life and now I believe that we come Home when our physical body dies!

arrival.other_being_detail: A "large group of people" welcoming her; and an "Another Consciousness" that "feels like our Father."

environment.environment_other_detail: Described as a "beautiful place" filled with "gorgeous white and golden rays of light."

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: She realized she "ha[d] not yet done what I am supposed to do" and chose to return to find and fulfill her purpose.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Pedestrian struck by a red car while crossing the road.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Immediate transition into a "different dimension" without an OBE or tunnel being described; then welcoming group, communication with Higher Consciousness, brief life review, choice to return, then awareness of voices/ambulance.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Witnesses reported the traffic light was still red, while she remembered it as green before being struck.
